chunks: "Glory to our Lord," they said; we were really in the wrong.
ai.seo_question: What did the disbelievers say when they realized their mistake on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the moment of ultimate regret where the disbelievers recognize that their self-imposed oppression (ẓulm) was a choice rather than divine compulsion. It highlights the transition from arrogance to humility, serving as a poignant reminder that the root of their misguidance was internal failure to reflect, a theme central to the concept of *taqwa* and self-accountability in Shi'i theology.
